expectations.text: Explains that corporate security gateways or link scanners fetch URLs on arrival and thereby trigger the GET unsubscribe
expectations.evidence: "Microsoft Safe Links, Proofpoint, Mimecast and Barracuda fetch every URL in a message when it arrives."

expectations.text: Explains the click-rate jump as scanner or bot clicks rather than real engagement
expectations.evidence: "The jump is machine traffic, not readers liking the issue more."

expectations.text: Recommends making the unsubscribe act only on POST, with GET showing a confirmation page
expectations.evidence: Fix 1: "Make unsubscribe POST-only. GET shows a confirm page with a button."

expectations.text: Gives a test order: GET the URL, confirm the seed is still subscribed, then POST, then confirm it is unsubscribed
expectations.evidence: "A GET on a seed address leaves it subscribed. A POST unsubscribes it with a 2xx and no redirect."

expectations.text: Warns that the confirmation page must not auto-submit with JavaScript because some scanners execute it
expectations.evidence: "No JavaScript auto-submit."

expectations.text: Flags that a base64-encoded email in the URL lets anyone unsubscribe anyone, and recommends an opaque token checked server-side
expectations.evidence: "Anyone can unsubscribe anyone by encoding an email address"; "opaque random token looked up server-side".

expectations.text: Recommends List-Unsubscribe with an HTTPS URI plus List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click
expectations.evidence: Fix 2: "HTTPS `List-Unsubscribe`, `List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click`".

expectations.text: States that the List-Unsubscribe headers must be covered by the DKIM signature (h= tag)
expectations.evidence: "both listed in the DKIM `h=` tag."

expectations.text: Says the unsubscribe endpoint must not return a redirect to the POST
expectations.evidence: "A POST unsubscribes it with a 2xx and no redirect."

expectations.text: Says the 18% open rate is not evidence of Gmail spam placement
expectations.evidence: "The 18% Gmail open rate does **not** show you're in spam."

expectations.text: Recommends filtering scanner clicks (seconds after delivery, cloud IPs, every link clicked) before reporting clicks or applying an inactivity rule
expectations.evidence: Fix 5: "Drop clicks within seconds of delivery, from cloud IPs, or on every link of one copy... Use it for any inactivity rule."

expectations.text: Says not to silently re-subscribe the readers removed by scanners, and to tell them how to resubscribe or restore only those who ask
expectations.evidence: Fix 4: "Don't re-add them silently. Send a short note on how to resubscribe, and restore anyone who asks."

expectations.text: Puts fixing the unsubscribe endpoint first in the fix plan
expectations.evidence: Fix 1 is the POST-only unsubscribe.

expectations.text: Suggests verifying the scanner hypothesis by comparing unsubscribe or click timestamps with delivery time
expectations.evidence: Fix 3: "Flag unsubscribes with no prior click, within seconds of delivery, from cloud IP ranges".

expectations.text: Mentions that sharing fernhill.dev with password resets is a later separation step (dedicated newsletter subdomain)
expectations.evidence: Fix 11: move digest to `news.fernhill.dev`, "Password resets stay on the root domain", Next quarter.
